title: You Think Vision Reads Every Object Alike, Yet One Tiny Brain Patch Builds Whole Faces
description:
You think your brain reads every object alike! Yet activating one tiny spot warps people alone! This is the true story of Nancy Kanwisher's scanner quest. Here is what went wrong with early brain maps.
